svg.aria-label: Runs passed, time and cost per model. 436 of 512 runs passed. A row per model, the best first by its pass rate, the mean of its tasks' shares of runs passed, and at the same rate the fastest first, with that rate, its runs passed, each task's share, the sums of its tasks' median wall times for board and trace, which ask to understand a photo, and for the other tasks, and its cost per passed run. The runs took place from 29 Oct to 21 Nov 2026.

svg.text: Runs passed, time and cost per model
436 of 512 runs passed. A row per model, the best first by its pass rate: the share of each task's
runs that passed, averaged over the 10 tasks, so that a task run more often does not weigh more, and at
the same rate the fastest first. Where a model ran some tasks more often, its pass rate differs from its
share of runs passed. Each time is the sum of its tasks' median wall times, the part in hyprmasq's tools in
blue. Board and trace stand apart: they also ask to understand a photo, and a model that cannot spends its
calls there. Its cost is per passed run.
Kimi K3.1 Pro asked for high effort and ran at max.
Coding agents doing desktop tasks through hyprmasq's MCP tools in offline NixOS VMs, 29 Oct to 21 Nov 2026.
A probe of hyprmasq with each model, no formal ranking of models. Builds and machines differ between sets.
